subject: Fear of education
alt: Cartoon: under a picture of a big leader on the wall, two leaders in saffron gamchhas are talking. One asks: why is it that whenever someone speaks of education it feels as if he is conspiring against us?
chutki: This cartoon asks an honest question, and the one asking belongs to that very camp: why is it that whenever someone speaks of education it feels as if he is conspiring against us? The answer perhaps hides in the question itself. An educated person asks questions, and for power nothing is a bigger conspiracy than a question.

Look at the gait of the two leaders: one has moved ahead, as if he does not want to hear this question at all. The picture peering from the wall behind is present in many of Dhodapkar's cartoons, like the photograph of the big boss in an office, below which everything is said in a low voice.
